title: Kohn anomaly in a 4 A carbon nanotube: nonadiabatic softening and the RBM instability

decision_points.fork: Does the archived DFPT frequency omega_Q already contain an electronic self-energy?
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take omega_b = omega_Q and add Pi(T) on top (double counting)
decision_points.consequence: nu = 20 softens to ~100 meV and the RBM is unstable at every archived temperature
decision_points.kind: physics, supported by the archived DFPT smearing scan

decision_points.fork: Which static self-energy is contained in omega_Q: the one at the DFPT smearing (0.01 Ry = 1578.87 K), not at the physical T or at 0.01 eV
decision_points.wrong_choice: Subtract the static self-energy at the same temperature T (or read degauss in eV)
decision_points.consequence: nu = 20 hardens above omega_Q (Omega ~ 145 meV) and the RBM never becomes unstable
decision_points.kind: metadata (degauss units, smearing) and released 1578.87 K table

decision_points.fork: Static (adiabatic) versus dynamic (nonadiabatic) self-energy for the mode-20 frequency
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the adiabatic static result for the nonadiabatic fields (or the converse)
decision_points.consequence: Omega(100 K) off by ~19 meV, Omega(300 K) by ~7 meV

decision_points.fork: Column identity of the archived self-energy tables: the header names 10 columns in an order that does not match the 8 data columns
decision_points.wrong_choice: Follow the header: take column 8 ('Real Sigma(w=0)') as the static self-energy
decision_points.consequence: The subtracted static part is ~0 (column 8 is Im Pi, which vanishes at w = 0): equivalent to double counting
decision_points.kind: archive defect visible only in the raw data

decision_points.fork: Scattering processes: k -> k+Q alone covers the zone; the authors' coupling-plot script sums k+q and k-q
decision_points.consequence: Self-energy doubled: Omega(300 K) 7 meV low, linewidth doubled, RBM T* ~ 910 K
decision_points.kind: bookkeeping; discriminated only by validation against an archived table

decision_points.fork: Band pairs in the energy-ordered Wannier basis: the Dirac crossing at E_F makes the 2k_F backscattering the 1<->2 pair
decision_points.wrong_choice: Keep only the intraband pairs (1,1) and (2,2)
decision_points.consequence: No Kohn anomaly: Omega ~ omega_Q, zero linewidth, no RBM instability
decision_points.kind: bookkeeping found in the coupling data

decision_points.fork: Convergence of the dynamic self-energy at low T (eta = k_B T/100): validation at high T does not transfer
decision_points.wrong_choice: Coarse sampling (nk = 1e5) at 100 K, or the raw 2000-point archived grid
decision_points.consequence: Linewidth at 100 K 10% low (1e5); raw grid: Omega 6-7 meV high and the linewidth almost zero
decision_points.kind: convergence regime; needs a low-temperature validation (released 50 K table)

decision_points.fork: Reference frequency and smearing scheme: omega_Q (cold-smearing DFPT behind the coupling data) versus the Fermi-Dirac DFPT smearing scan
decision_points.wrong_choice: Anchor on the Fermi-Dirac 10 mRy frequency, or use the scan with sigma as temperature for T*
decision_points.consequence: RBM T* ~ 330 K or ~ 204 K instead of ~ 527 K; nu = 20 frequencies 8 meV high

decision_points.fork: Mass parameter of the archived threshold program: the variable called mass is a = 1/m*
decision_points.wrong_choice: Pass m* = 2 as the program parameter
decision_points.kind: archive naming inconsistency (main() mass_params, function doc a = 1/m*, fig1.py reversed labels)

decision_points.fork: Omega(T) of nu = 20 is non-monotonic (minimum near omega_Q/4.6 k_B): withheld temperatures must be computed
decision_points.wrong_choice: Interpolate the released tables (50 K and 700 K)
decision_points.consequence: Omega(300 K) 1.9 meV high; RBM T* ~ 370 K
decision_points.kind: regime judgement under a binding budget

length_estimate.why: validation of the evaluator at low and high T, self-energies at two withheld temperatures, a temperature bracket for T*, the reference smearing, the threshold program, and archive inspection

runtime_dependencies: numpy and scipy (runtime image); gcc (runtime image) only if the agent compiles the archived C model
notes: Truth: Eq. (6)-(7) complex pole on the archived self-energy tables at the withheld temperatures, with the static part of the released 1578.87 K table subtracted (the authors' protocol, fig2_d_f_h.py); T* from the Omega -> 0 limit of the pole across the archived 500-600 K tables; g0 from the archived coupling_calculator.c rebuilt with a parametrised main(). The lab evaluator reproduces the archived tables to 0.17 meV. Paper-text thresholds (54.5 and 129.0 meV) disagree with the archived program and with Eq. (9) and fail the threshold check.
